chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Awass al-Ta'i, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who marries a woman but does not have what he can give her (the dowry), and he consummates the marriage with her. He said: There is no objection; it is merely a debt upon him owed to her.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman and has sex with her before paying her dowry?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that consummating marriage before full payment of the dowry is legally permissible, transforming the unpaid portion into a binding debt (dayn) rather than invalidating the union. This ruling underscores the flexibility in marital contracts within Shia jurisprudence, prioritizing the validity of the marriage contract over the immediate liquidity of the dowry, while ensuring the wife’s financial rights are preserved as a secured claim against the husband.
